alt: Annotated diagram of the Trump International Airport eagle logo with arrows pointing out deformed mismatched talons, unequal wing feathers, and wrong number of shield stripes
story: Palm Beach airport was renamed Donald J. Trump International Airport in July 2026, but the grand new welcome-sign logo appears to be AI-generated — the eagle has deformed talons of different shapes, wings with mismatched feather counts, and only 11 stripes on its shield instead of the correct 13.
why_funny: They renamed an entire international airport and put a giant sign out front, then apparently asked an AI for the logo and didn't look too closely at the talons.
